# physio-booking-backend

Scheduling backend for the FisioSud chain of physiotherapy clinics.
Handles treatment slots, bookings, therapist availability and reminders.

events.title: M1 Booking core
events.what: Patients can book, list and cancel treatment sessions at any clinic of the chain.

events.ref: chat 2026-03-02: booking core with slot grid, patient profiles, booking endpoint, storage and cancellation

events.message: feat(slots): generate daily slot grid per clinic

events.why: Insurers bill physiotherapy in 15-minute units, so the slot length matches the billing unit.

events.message: feat(slots): skip lunch break between 13:00 and 14:00
test(slots): cover grid boundaries and lunch break
feat(patients): validate fiscal code checksum at registration
events.why: Insurers reject invoices whose patient fiscal code fails the checksum, so it is validated at registration.

events.title: Fix timezone offset in slot dates
events.what: Slots created at 9:00 Europe/Rome come back as 8:00 in the booking response, so front desks see wrong times.

events.message: fix(time): build slot dates in Europe/Rome
test(time): cover DST switch on 29 March
feat(booking): reject overlapping bookings for the same therapist
events.why: One therapist cannot treat two patients at once, so overlaps are checked per therapist.

files.docs/api.md:
# Booking API

- `POST /bookings` creates a booking (409 on therapist overlap)
- `GET /bookings?patient=<id>` lists a patient's bookings
- `DELETE /bookings/:id` cancels a booking

Times are sent in UTC; clinics run on Europe/Rome.

events.message: feat(cancel): charge late cancellations under 24 hours
events.why: Clinic policy charges the session fee when a patient cancels less than 24 hours before the session.

events.what: Therapists and rooms publish when they can be booked, and patients get SMS reminders.

events.ref: chat 2026-03-16: availability rules for therapists, rooms and holidays, then SMS reminders

steps.title: Reminder SMS retry on gateway errors

events.message: feat(availability): weekly working hours per therapist
events.why: Therapists work part-time across several clinics, so hours are stored per therapist and per clinic.

events.message: feat(availability): filter slot grid by therapist hours
feat(availability): treatment rooms with equipment tags
events.why: Shockwave and hydrotherapy sessions need a room with that equipment, so a free therapist is not enough.

files.docs/availability.md:
# Availability model

A slot is bookable when the therapist works, a suitable room is free and the clinic is open.

## Regional holidays

Sardinian clinics close on Sa Die de sa Sardigna (28 April), which national holiday calendars miss.
Closed days are therefore kept per clinic in `data/holidays/<clinic>.json`, not taken from a national calendar.

events.message: feat(availability): load closed days per clinic from a holidays file

events.title: Release slot when a booking is cancelled
events.what: Cancelled bookings still block their slot, and the Quartu front desk cannot rebook it.

events.message: fix(booking): free the slot on cancellation
test(booking): cancelled slot can be booked again
feat(availability): compute Easter Monday each year
test(availability): Sa Die de sa Sardigna closes Cagliari clinics
feat(sms): Twilio client for outgoing SMS

files.docs/twilio-setup.md:
# Twilio setup

1. Create a Twilio project and buy an Italian number.
2. Set `TWILIO_SID`, `TWILIO_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_FROM` in `.env`.
3. Reminders are sent from that number, 24 hours before each session.

events.ref: chat 2026-03-23: drop Twilio and send reminders through Skebby with the clinic name as sender

events.message: feat(sms): Skebby client for outgoing SMS
events.why: Twilio needs weeks of sender ID registration for Italian numbers, while Skebby sends with the clinic name as alphanumeric sender right away.

events.message: docs: SMS gateway setup, supersedes the Twilio notes

files.docs/sms-gateway.md:
# SMS gateway

Supersedes `twilio-setup.md`: reminders now go through Skebby.

1. Set `SKEBBY_USER` and `SKEBBY_SESSION` in `.env`.
2. The sender is the clinic name (alphanumeric, max 11 chars).

events.message: feat(reminders): SMS reminder 24 hours before a new booking
events.why: The reminder goes out 24 hours before so patients still have time to cancel without the late fee.

events.message: feat(reminders): hourly scheduler for due reminders

events.title: Fix CI waiting for Postgres
events.what: CI runs fail because tests start before the Postgres service accepts connections.

events.message: ci: wait for Postgres before running tests

files.scripts/wait-for-pg.sh:
#!/bin/sh
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 && exit 0
  sleep 1
done
echo 'postgres not ready' >&2
exit 1
files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env: { POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dev }
        ports: ['5432:5432']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20 }
      - run: sh scripts/wait-for-pg.sh && npm ci && npm test

files.docs/billing.md:
# Billing

Insurers are invoiced once a month for completed sessions of their members.
Tariffs come from `data/insurers.json`; amounts are in cents.
Patients without an insurer pay at the front desk and are not invoiced here.

events.message: feat(invoices): group completed sessions by insurer and month
feat(invoices): invoice totals from insurer tariffs
feat(invoices): invoice numbering per clinic and year
events.why: Italian invoicing rules require a progressive number per issuer and year, so numbers restart every January for each clinic.
